items.title: 61531_Juan Tizol oral history interview
items.q: Harry called me about Juan because he called me, you know, first, and he said, "Rose, I'm getting ready to get my band together and I'd like for Juan to be in it."

ctx.x: It's only so many ways that he'd pay you off. About to split the one nighters with theatre, with recording and this and the other. That's when I told him, "No, you give me so much a week -- you give me so much every week, work or don't work." But extractions come cost extra.

Harry called me about Juan because he called me, you know, first, and he said, "Rose, I'm getting ready to get my band together and I'd like for Juan to be in it." And he said, "Where can I find Juan?" So I told him, and he said, "How much salary an hour do you think he'd want?" and I said, "I don't have the slightest idea, but don't think you can get him for nothing, because he doesn't don't work for nothing."

So he asked me for the telephone number, and I called Juan immediately and told him that Harry was going to call, and then Harry called him. Probably Harry called him while I was on the phone with him, you know, and the line was busy, and then Harry called him and told him. But I'd already tipped Juan off.
